FN-29DXSII-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 33
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Chris Elliott
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/07/2024
Senate Bill 33 as introduced would provide for three-year performance-based contracts for new
assistant administrative officers employed on or after July 1, 2024. Additionally, it provides for
duties, termination, and the appeal of employment actions, as well as the hearing process for
contract assistant administrative officers. The provisions of this bill could increase the
obligations of participating local boards of education, by an undetermined amount, depending
upon the number of terminations and appeals.
